name: nbr-crm
description: National Book of Records — Backend CRM (Phase 1 & 2)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @nbr/shared build && pnpm --filter @nbr/api build && pnpm --filter @nbr/web build
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio mailpit && node scripts/wait-for-infra.mjs
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm --filter @nbr/shared build && pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
